item.title: MCP Server Statistics (November 2026)
item.description:
On 2026-11-21, the MCP reference servers repository had the most GitHub stars of the 12 projects we checked: 92,135. The MCP TypeScript SDK had the most npm downloads: 386,037,353 in the last month. The MCP Python SDK had the most PyPI downloads: 331,376,908. The SDK numbers are high because many other tools depend on them, so they count installs, not people running a server.

These numbers were pulled by aiagentmemory.org on 2026-11-21 from the GitHub, PyPI and npm APIs. The table is the script’s output, pasted without edits. The exact calls are in the Methodology section. For how these servers store memory, read AI memory MCP servers.

item.title: Vector Database Statistics (November 2026)
item.description:
On 2026-11-21, Milvus had the most GitHub stars of the 8 vector databases we checked: 46,711. The pgvector Python package had the most PyPI downloads: 43,629,382 in the last month. Pinecone’s npm package had the most npm downloads: 4,830,781. Downloads count installs of a client package, not servers running in production.

These numbers were pulled by aiagentmemory.org on 2026-11-21 from the GitHub, PyPI and npm APIs. The table is the script’s output, pasted without edits. The exact calls are in the Methodology section. For how these databases fit into agent memory, read best in-memory vector databases and vector databases for LLM memory.

item.title: AI Coding Agent Statistics (November 2026)
item.description:
OpenClaw has the most GitHub stars of 12 AI coding agents we checked: 394,915 on 2026-11-20. Codex CLI has the most npm downloads: 115,733,979 in the last month. Stars show interest, not how well an agent works, and downloads count installs, not active users.

These numbers were pulled by aiagentmemory.org on 2026-11-20 from the GitHub, PyPI and npm APIs. The table is the script’s output, pasted without edits. The exact calls are in the Methodology section. Memory data for the same tools is on Claude Code memory and Codex memory.
